assertions.name: gram_strictly_positive_on_the_support
assertions.source: min of frobenius_gram_diag over the convention-D support

description: The convention-D zero-weight sector is the Temperley-Lieb ideal I_n, not an unpriced sector: the support's squared dimensions sum to Catalan(n) = dim TL_n exactly, at n = 2..8. Per prop:markov-trace-frobenius-selection (iii), (TL_n, tr_M) is the symmetric Frobenius algebra and the pairing is non-degenerate there. This closes the signed-occupation escape -- G is strictly positive on the support, so Gx >= 0 IS x >= 0 -- and makes the support projection the quotient map H_n -> TL_n rather than a modelling choice.
caveats: Scope (a). Uses parts (i) and (iii) of prop:markov-trace-frobenius-selection, which the corpus states UNCONDITIONALLY. Part (ii) -- that the row cap follows from the mass-channel trace being the categorical trace of the SU_q(2) fibre action -- has an OPEN antecedent (bean qou-n1dj) and is neither used nor supported here.

Corrects this arc's own framing twice over: the zero-weight sector is not an 'unpriced overdraft' (nothing prices a radical -- the algebra is the quotient), and the support projection is not a modelling decision but the quotient map H_6 -> TL_6.
Nothing here computes a binding contribution or bears on whether the framework can reach AME. It establishes WHERE the program lives, not what it yields.
